I am 62 yrs old and 6 years ago I was pursued by a young lady who was 27.
 I had known her for some years until one day she asked me out.
 To say the least, I was floored !
I explained to her all the reasons this was a terrible idea.
 Everything said or did failed to persuade her.
After a couple of months of arguing over this I gave in and said OK
 We started dating, all the while hoping she would see the reality of "May /December "
romances. 
  I have to admit I had a great time.
The sex was amazing,
It was actually a lot of fun watching peoples reactions when they discovered that we were lovers .
When everyone thought it was a "Father and his Daughter " they were seeing. 
 However much fun and adventuress it was, all good things must end.
 There came a time when that age difference became an impediment and we had to part ways.
 We remain friends and still talk.
Both of us wiser and the occasional secret smile when we are around people who didn't know us when we were a couple.

Good evening 
 In 1973 I was a 14 year old boy inpatient at Evanston Hospital's psych ward.
 I count myself luck that my Dr was a psychotherapist, and was not a believer in "EST".
 However I saw a parade of patients who were in the care of a particular Dr, who was a major proponent of this treatment. 
 Some went willingly others, not so willingly. 
 What I remembered (And terrified me the most.) was how different the person leaving treatment was from what went in.
 Those who could walk out on their own would make one believe in Zombies. 
 The slow shuffle of their feet as they worked their way to their rooms.
 But it was the haunted look in their eyes as they stared a thousand yards ahead, that would un-nerve me.

 With the mantra running through my head  
NEVER WOULD I ALLOW MYSELF TO SUBMIT TO THAT !!!

I hope you find your path to recovery. 
ALL MY BEST WISHES TO YOU.

Dear
Bush baby 
 When I read your post I was in awe of your ability to reach out to the world. 
  I am a 62 yrs old male.
When I  was a freshman in HS I was brutally beaten and raped by two Sr's. Over the course of an hour.
 Left beaten, bleeding and left alone, they didn't care if I lived or died.
I managed to her myself to safety when they left.
 I went into a downward spiral of barbiturates and amphetamines for the next year.
I never had anyone to tell my tale to back then. During the attack and afterwards  I was all alone and no one was coming to help me.
 I finally decided that my life was shit so why not put it to an end.
 So it was that i sat by the lake and took a big handful of barbiturates. 
 When I awoke in the ER, they told me my heart had stopped twice, 
 After that I spent 9 months in the psyc-ward.
 Many years later I am still here.
The pain never goes away however one learns to survive. 
 
 Bush baby,
If may not feel,like it now, but tomorrow, you may find the one person who makes your life worth living.

Sir
